title: Gold
wikitext: {{Item |rarity_id = normal |name = Gold |class_id = Gold |size_x = 1 |size_y = 1 |drop_level = 1 |tags = default |metadata_id = Metadata/Items/Currency/GoldCoin |stack_size = 50000 |description = Can be spent at Vendors |stack_size_currency_tab = 50000 |inventory_icon = CoinPileTier2 |is_sellable = false |release_version = 3.20.2b }} '''Gold''' is a collectable item that drops from monsters and loot containers that can be used to pay for various goods and services. Gold is ''not'' a tradable form of [[Currency item|currency]]. ==Mechanics== Any gold on the ground within the character's pickup range will be collected automatically upon moving or teleporting using a skill like {{il|Flicker Strike}}. Gold does not take up any inventory space. The amount of gold a character holds can be seen on the Inventory screen. Gold cannot be traded with other players or dropped on the ground. Gold is shared between all characters within the same league. ==Uses== [[File:Passive_Respec_to_lvl_70.jpg|thumb|Player passive tree respec gold cost per point between Level 1-70, recorded during [[version 3.25.0]].]] [[Vendor]]s have various options to spend gold: * Respecialisation allows the player to respec passives on the [[passive skill tree]] or the [[Atlas passive skill tree]] for gold instead of Refund Points ({{il|Orb of Regret}} or {{il|Orb of Unmaking}}). The cost increases based on [[character level]]. * Players can gamble for items and spend gold to buy a piece of equipment of random rarity. Starting from [[Act 6]], [[Faustus]] grants access to the [[Currency Exchange Market]] and [[asynchronous trading]], allowing the player to exchange currency and other fungible items or purchase items from other players, which incurs a gold fee for each transaction. [[Commander Kirac]]'s sells non-unique maps for gold and his vendor stock can be refreshed by paying gold, which increases in cost as you progress through the Atlas, capping at 10,000 gold. Gold can be used in [[Kingsmarch]] to hire workers and pay their wages. All time-based activities in Kingsmarch incur a gold cost over time, which is taken from the Treasury. The player may freely deposit and withdraw gold from the Treasury by speaking to [[Johan, the King's Hand]]. Gold can also be used to reroll a port's favoured resources. The [[Recombinator]] crafting bench requires gold and Thaumaturgic Dust to use. [[Cadiro Perandus]] appears in [[Immortal Syndicate]] Research Safehouses with [[Janus Perandus]] stationed there. He sells a selection of unique items for gold. Cadiro also appears in [[The Manor Foyer]], where he will offer one unique item for sale for gold. His offer can be rerolled a limited number of times. The gold cost increases each time the item is rerolled. Before dueling a [[Mercenary]], you must pay them a gold fee. If you defeat the mercenary, the paid gold will be refunded. When a permanently hired mercenary (via the [[Luminary]]) dies, they will instead retreat, but they will not follow you unless you pay a gold fee to "revive" them. {{Item acquisition}} Gold drops are obtained in the following ways: * Higher rarity monsters can drop additional stacks of gold when killed. These drops likely scale with increased [[item quantity]].{{guesswork}} ** Monsters added from [[Extra Content]] and such tend to drop less gold than from naturally spawned monsters. * Gold can be obtained through [[Monster_modifiers#Reward_modifiers|monster reward modifier]] conversion from the following modifiers: ** monster_equipment_drops_converted_to_gold_% ** map_rare_monster_equipment_drops_converted_to_gold_% ** map_unique_monster_equipment_drops_converted_to_gold_% *** This only converts [[equipment]] items. Higher rarity equipment will be converted into larger quantities of gold, influenced by both increased quantity and [[rarity]] and the number of monster modifiers on an enemy. ==Alternate icons== During the Ruthless with Gold event when gold was an item, the item's icon changed dynamically based on the stack size. The default inventory icon is the medium size pile. {| | [[File:Gold (small pile).png]] || Stack size of 1 to 999 |- | [[File:Gold (medium pile).png]] || Stack size of 1000 to 4999 |- | [[File:Gold (large pile).png]] || Stack size of 5000 or greater |} ==Related items== {{Drop enabled item table |where = items.class_id NOT LIKE "%Microtransaction%" AND items.class_id NOT LIKE "%Divination%Card%" AND items.description LIKE "%Gold%" |large=1 |description=1 }} ===Unique items=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%gold%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} * [[Foulborn]] {{il|Goldwyrm}} ({{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueBootsDex2IncreasedGold|(20-30)% increased Quantity of Gold Dropped by Slain Enemies]]}}) * [[Foulborn]] {{il|Aurseize}} ({{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueGlovesStrDex2IncreasedGold|15% increased Quantity of Gold Dropped by Slain Enemies]]}}) * [[Foulborn]] {{il|Sadima's Touch}} ({{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueGlovesInt1IncreasedGold|(5-15)% increased Quantity of Gold Dropped by Slain Enemies]]}}) ==Trivia== The currency used by the Kalguurans and residents of [[Kingsmarch]] is called the ''Dinar''. ==Version history== Gold was first used in the [[Ruthless with Gold]] event. It was reintroduced in [[Settlers league]] as part of the [[Kingsmarch]] settlement building content. Gold was added to the core game in [[version 3.26.0]]. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.28.0| * Increased the penalty to Gold and Map drops on Breach and Blight monsters. * All Unique Maps now have a fee of around 2000 Gold when purchasing from a Merchant Tab. * Itemised Beasts have vastly lower Gold fees, and their Gold fees no longer depend on the modifiers on the Itemised Beasts. * Fixed a bug where increased Quantity of Gold Dropped by Slain Enemies was only applied to enemies you killed with hits, rather than any kill attributed to you. }} {{Version history table row|3.27.0| * You are now able to fully refund your Passive Tree with one click for a gold cost. * Refunding of Atlas Passive Points can now be done with Gold. Speak to Kirac to access this option. You can now also fully refund your Atlas Passive Tree with one click for a gold cost. * The stack size of Gold dropped has been globally increased by ~15% at all levels. The penalties to Gold from Harbinger, Legion, Ultimatum, Expedition, Abyss, Bestiary, Affliction and Harvest monsters have been lowered. * Gold fees for most basic Currency items that are commonly traded in bulk on the Currency Exchange (such as Orbs of Fusing) have been reduced. Gold fees for Wild, Vivid, and Primal Crystallised Lifeforce as well as Currency Shards have also been reduced. }} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Gold can drop from slain monsters which will be used for paying workers' wages, as well as Passive Skill Tree Respecialisation and purchasing items from the Black Market at a number of NPCs throughout Wraeclast. * Item description changed from "Used as Currency in Kingsmarch" to "Can be spent at Vendors".{{Undocumented}} * Gold has been implemented as a core [[game mechanic]] and its drop rates in across the entire game have been rebalanced. ** Removed penalties to gold that existed on monsters and chests in [[Heist]]. ** Removed penalties to gold that existed on monsters and chests in [[Blight]]. ** Increased the amount of gold given at the end of each [[Simulacrum]] wave. ** Removed penalties to gold that existed on monsters in [[Delve]]. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Breach (original)|Breach]] monsters. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Abyss]] monsters and chests. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Delirium]] monsters. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Beyond]] monsters. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Legion]] monsters. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Incursion]] monsters in maps and in temples. ** Lowered penalties to gold on [[Bestiary]] monsters. * Added the Gilded Font to the end of each [[Sanctum]] floor. This allows players to convert 50% of their current Aureus to gold. The ratio of this conversion is greater at higher levels. }} {{Version history table row|3.25.3g| * Gold in both your inventory and in your Kingsmarch Treasury will be preserved, but will not be visible or usable until the launch of 3.26.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3787069 }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0b| * Gold within pickup range is now automatically picked up when you teleport away through means such as Flicker Strike. }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Reintroduced the Gold system as part of Settlers league, this time as a non-tradeable resource similar to [[Azurite]]. }} {{Version history table row|3.20.2b| * Introduced to the game exclusively for the Ruthless with Gold event as a tradeable item. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web | author = MorningPaisley | date = June 7, 2025 | title = Info from ZiggyD Q&A | url = https://www.reddit.com/r/PathOfExileBuilds/comments/1l5jy16/info_from_ziggyd_qa/ | publisher = Reddit | accessdate = June 7, 2025 }} }} {{sister|poe2wiki}}
